title: Strict decrease of majority Fourier weights
statement: For every nonnegative integer $j$, the sequence indexed by nonnegative integers $r$ whose $r$th term is the level-$(2j+1)$ Fourier weight of majority on the Boolean cube of dimension $2(j+r)+1$ is strictly decreasing.
